config.purpose: Single-seed exploratory supervised baseline on all training groups, no LLM and no physics loss. Not a data-size-only or epoch-count-only causal ablation. Test stays locked.

pressure_target_convention: Per-sample mean pressure removed only on SDF>0 points; solid pressure set to zero. Each validation target uses its own mean, no train/test statistics.
